title: Kiingereza kwa wazungumzaji wa Kiswahili
description: Kiingereza ni lugha ya shule, kazi na biashara Afrika Mashariki, na huzungumzwa duniani kote.
notes: Drafted by Claude (AI) from the en-sw course: the English and the Swahili both need a native-speaker review (see journal/2026-10-22-english-for-swahili.md). Sections 1–4 (units 1–32) so far; Section 5 follows in #147.

why.title: Lugha ya **shule na kazi.**
why.text: Kiingereza hutumika shuleni, ofisini, mahakamani na kwenye mtandao kote Afrika Mashariki. Jifunze ili usome, upate kazi, na uzungumze na watu wa dunia nzima.

cards.title: Shuleni
cards.text: Elewa walimu na vitabu, na ufaulu mitihani.

cards.title: Kazini
cards.text: Andika, zungumza na fanya kazi na watu tofauti kwa kujiamini.

cards.title: Duniani
cards.text: Ongea na wageni, safiri na usome mtandaoni.

landing.farewell: Thank you very much — asante sana.
landing.audience: Wazungumzaji wa Kiswahili wanaotaka kujifunza Kiingereza tangu mwanzo: wanafunzi, wafanyakazi, na wazazi wanaotaka kuwasaidia watoto wao shuleni.
landing.first: Salamu, kujitambulisha na namba, kisha familia, chakula, sokoni, saa, mjini, nyumbani na afya, sehemu kwa sehemu.

sections.title: Misingi
sections.description: Salamu, familia, chakula, namba na saa, mjini, nyumbani, siku yako na afya.

sections.title: Maisha ya kila siku
sections.description: Eleza vitu, vaa nguo, saidia nyumbani, hali ya hewa, wanyama, kazi, shule na usafiri.

sections.title: Mazungumzo
sections.description: Kataa, uliza maswali, zungumza kuhusu yaliyopita na yajayo, hisia, burudani, simu na upishi.

sections.title: Jamii na utamaduni
sections.description: Pwani ya Waswahili, kijiji na kilimo, sherehe, muziki, imani, biashara, mazingira na jamii.
